reference.qualification: Reference signatures and RDG examples are from jsuk10/UE4.27plus_Custom; exact identity with Bright Memory v1.34 engine snapshot is unverified.

upscaler_methods: AddPasses(FRDGBuilder&, const FViewInfo&, const FInputs&) const
verified_contract.view_family_assignment: SetPrimarySpatialUpscalerInterface(ISpatialUpscaler*) is assign-once and checkf-rejects a second primary assignment.
verified_contract.view_family_ownership: FSceneViewFamily::~FSceneViewFamily deletes the primary ISpatialUpscaler through ISceneViewFamilyExtention
verified_contract.fork_behavior: FSceneRenderer forks the primary upscaler with Fork_GameThread when copying a view family

integration_constraints: ISpatialUpscaler is declared in a Renderer private header, not a public plugin API.
FSceneViewFamily rejects a null primary upscaler and rejects a second primary assignment.
The extension must be retained by a shared reference for as long as it is registered.
A normal plugin using only public Engine headers cannot safely implement this interface.
The reference fork is not proven identical to the Bright Memory v1.34 engine snapshot.
A view extension cannot overwrite an already assigned primary spatial upscaler; BMI must be installed at the engine's original assignment site in the matching Renderer source.

target_rhi.evidence: DefaultEngine.ini and Android device profile inspection
